_comment: SC flight model (flight_core::sc::angular::AngularTuning). TODO(initiator): every value. rate rad/s at full stick (pitch, yaw and roll share one ellipsoid budget); boost_rate multipliers on rate at full boost; rate_over_speed (x speed over the cap, y share of the rates, a corner speed). natural_frequency 1/s and damping_ratio per pitch and yaw: a second-order spring on the rate, below 1 it overshoots and settles (about 0.5 here); the angular acceleration stays inside the torque box (sc_ship.json torque over inertia). reversal_share: share of that box for a reversal (constant deceleration until the spin crosses zero). roll_decay 1/s: first order roll. roll_release_share: share of the box for a roll release (constant deceleration to zero). landing_rate_share: share of the rates in landing mode near the ground, full below landing_full_below m and off above landing_off_above m. g_limit: g per direction for the G-safe turn cap (forward, backward, left, right, up, down; the same numbers as the axis model's g_safety.limit, own copy).
